banner.subtitle: YOUR PLANTERA WORKSPACE
banner.title: Welcome
banner.description: A dedicated application for configuring, programming and managing PlantERA devices, providing a unified workspace for device provisioning, firmware management and secure hardware initialization.

cards.title: Device Provisioning
cards.description: Configure, initialize and register PlantERA devices. Manage hardware parameters, device identification and prepare devices for integration with the PlantERA platform.

cards.title: Firmware Management
cards.description: Manage firmware versions and software updates for PlantERA devices. Maintain compatibility, improve device functionality and ensure consistent firmware deployment.

cards.title: Device Security
cards.description: Protect PlantERA devices through secure configuration, cryptographic key management and role-based access control.
